headline: Fishermen's Row Falls Silent as Lykos Isle Flares
war_summary: With this edition the front that led our last report has hushed: Fishermen's Row, which counted eight base events in two hours at evening filing, records none in the hours since, though its ledger stands six works Colonial to three Warden and its casualty columns cool steadily from heavy heights. Lykos Isle now claims the freshest action, new events logged as late as half past ten, its works split four Warden to three Colonial and its losses accelerating in the latest hour. The Deadlands renewed base movement in the evening, seven works flying Colonial colors against four Warden, with tolls easing from their enormous peaks; Stlican Shelf's climbing rates, noted at last filing, now cool. Loch Mor and Clahstra register sharply rising casualty figures without recorded base events, and the Weathered Expanse continues its immense hemorrhage, near three thousand in two hours, all nine of its works still in Warden keeping. Kings Cage, Linn Mercy, Endless Shore, Stonecradle and Tempest Island remain quiet. Fifty-six days in, no victor is declared and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
